name: getdents
synopsis: long syscall(SYS_getdents, unsigned int fd, struct linux_dirent *dirp, unsigned int count);
ssize_t getdents64(int fd, void *dirp, size_t count);
description: The system call getdents() reads several directory entries from the directory referred to by the open file descriptor fd into the buffer pointed to by dirp. The argument count specifies the size of that buffer. It is a low-level interface, and users are generally advised to use readdir(3) for POSIX-conforming operations.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the directory to read from

parameters.name: dirp
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to hold the directory entries

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Size of the buffer pointed to by dirp

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes read on success, or 0 on end of directory
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Argument points outside the calling process’s address space
File descriptor does not refer to a directory
